user.title: Pro Weather
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.station: Weather station: readings, forecast and warnings
menu_options.solar: Solar forecast: your panels' power forecast (Pro plan)

station.title: Pro Weather station
station.description: Enter the station's address, for example ardooie.pro-weather.com, its own domain, or just ardooie. Any published Pro Weather station works, no token needed.

solar.title: Pro Weather solar forecast
solar.description: Paste the API token from your site's dashboard, under Setup > Solar forecast. It starts with pws_.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless you are testing against a staging server or a mock.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token needed
reauth_confirm.description: Pro Weather no longer accepts the saved token. It was probably regenerated or revoked. Paste the current token from Setup > Solar forecast.

error.invalid_auth: Pro Weather does not recognise this token. Copy it again from Setup > Solar forecast.
error.plan_required: The solar forecast is part of the Pro plan, and this site is not on it.
error.not_set_up: The token works, but there is nothing to forecast yet: add your panels under Setup > Solar forecast, and make sure the station has a location.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests from your network in the last hour. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Pro Weather. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_url: The server address must start with https:// or http://.
error.not_found: No published Pro Weather station at this address.
error.invalid_station: That is not a station address. Try something like ardooie.pro-weather.com.

abort.reauth_successful: The new token works. The forecast is back.

init.title: Options
init.description:
A new forecast arrives once an hour. Polling more often than every 15 minutes gains nothing.

Pick the energy sensor that counts what your panels make (the one the Energy dashboard uses for solar production) and the integration sends each finished hour to Pro Weather, so the forecast learns the shade and dirt your station cannot see.

data_description.production_sensor: Optional. An energy sensor in kWh or Wh for all your panels together. Leave empty to send nothing.
